## UI polish: Team settings row 16 fixes across spacing, typography, hierarchy, states, layout and tokens. Text and brand hue kept. Tokens from tokens.css. ### Fixes 1. **Spacing**: `.row` `gap: 10px` is off the scale. Now `gap: var(--space-12)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 2. **Spacing**: `.row` `padding: 14px` is off the scale. Now `padding: var(--space-16)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 3. **Spacing**: `.badge` `padding: 2px 8px` is off the scale. Now `padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-8)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 4. **Spacing**: `.row a` `padding: 6px 12px` is off the scale. Now `padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-12)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 5. **Typography**: the description `p` uses `font-size: 14px`, which is below the 16 px body minimum. Now `font-size: var(--font-size-md)`. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-20) 6. **Typography**: the description `p` has no line-height and no max-width. Now `line-height: var(--line-height-body); max-width: var(--measure)`. (R-ui-polish-3, R-ui-polish-20) 7. **Typography**: `h3` uses the browser's `line-height: normal`. Now `line-height: var(--line-height-heading)`. (R-ui-polish-3, R-ui-polish-20) 8. **Typography**: `h3` uses the browser's bold weight (700), next to the regular 400 elsewhere. Now `font-weight: var(--font-weight-strong)`, so the row uses only the two token weights. (R-ui-polish-8, R-ui-polish-20) 9. **Hierarchy**: "Invite" is the one primary action and uses raw `background: #0f766e; color: #ffffff`. Now `background: var(--color-action-primary-bg); color: var(--color-action-primary-text)`, with `text-decoration: none` so it reads as a filled button. (R-ui-polish-5, R-ui-polish-21) 10. **States**: "Invite" has no hover, pressed or focus style. Now hover is `var(--color-action-primary-bg-hover)`, `:active` is `var(--color-action-primary-bg-pressed)`, and `:focus-visible` is `outline: var(--border-width-focus) solid var(--color-border-focus); outline-offset: 2px`. (R-ui-polish-6, R-ui-polish-20) 11. **Layout**: "Invite" is about 30 px tall, under the 44 px target. Now `min-height: var(--size-target-min); min-width: var(--size-target-min)`, with `display: inline-flex` to centre the label and `align-items: center` on `.row` so the items line up. (R-ui-polish-7, R-ui-polish-20) 12. **Tokens**: colours `#ffffff` (row background), `#202d2c` (heading) and `#4a6462` (description) are raw values. Now `var(--color-surface-default)`, `var(--color-text-default)` and `var(--color-text-muted)`. (R-ui-polish-20) 13. **Tokens**: font sizes `18px` (heading) and `12px` (badge) are raw values. Now `var(--font-size-lg)` and `var(--font-size-xs)`. (R-ui-polish-20) 14. **Tokens**: `font-family: system-ui` is a raw value. Now `font-family: var(--font-family-sans)`. (R-ui-polish-20) 15. **Tokens**: radii `9999px` (badge) and `6px` (button) are raw values. Now `var(--radius-full)` and `var(--radius-control)`. (R-ui-polish-20) 16. **Tokens**: the heading and description had only browser default margins inside a flex row. Now `margin: 0` on both, so the row's `gap` sets all the spacing.
